applyTo: "**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,vue,swift,kt,kts,gd,tscn}"

# CIS frontend context authority

- Canonical screen and route meaning remains in `docs/references/screen-route-map.md`; normalized context is derived.
- Run discovery and strict validation before graph-based frontend impact analysis.
- Duplicate providers and route collisions fail closed.
- Derived observations route source inspection and do not prove behavior, access control, accessibility, or design approval.
- Exclude dependencies, builds, generated output, coverage, Git, and `.cis/local/`.
